method: Structural trace through recorded base-action links; route boundaries from the S1-A03 census; browser coverage from the V2 required checks. Not a line-by-line implementation proof.

evidence.v2Qualification: Chromium desktop and mobile emulation only
evidence.limitation: Physical devices and other browser engines are not exercised.

evidence.v2Qualification: V2 browser journeys: named controls, visible error feedback, keyboard sign-in and reopening, no horizontal overflow, four profiles
evidence.limitation: Declared accessibility checks only; full WCAG certification is not established.

evidence.v2Qualification: V2 browser journeys in en-CA and fr-CA on desktop and mobile
evidence.limitation: The journeys exercised in both languages; every UI state in both languages is not established.
